title: Flavor Details: alignment
description: Schema of flavor field for alignment flavor. Content files follow the Scripture Burrito Alignment Format.
$comment: currentScope is intentionally not required for alignment burritos. Unlike scripture and audio burritos — where currentScope declares which books and chapters are present — alignment files record their own reference coverage internally (each alignment entry carries its source and target references). A top-level scope declaration would be redundant and would need to be kept in sync with the alignment content.
